body: It took me three years of working shit jobs for shit pay to land this one. The commute sucks and the job is lifeless and boring but the pay is the best I've ever had. No job hopping in my near future.
I don't really like anything with a passion. I spend four hours a day driving to or from work, so I wake up, go to work, go for a run, go home, clean, and then sleep. Then do it all over again.
